open_points.subject: change_staff_status
open_points.text: A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp, because the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address; the recorded value is a record only and decides no sign-in, which depends on the active status alone.
open_points.other_text: - authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST normalize email, accept only an account whose status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE with a password verify_password matches, deciding nothing on email_verified_at, issue a hashed fixed-expiry session, audit success or concealed failure, and never reveal which check failed: every rejection raises what conceal_authentication_failure returns.
open_points.question: Must the first passage say only that email_verified_at does not decide sign-in, rather than that sign-in depends on active status alone, or must authenticate_staff stop requiring a matching password?
